plan: Second-price sealed-bid auction: truth-telling is dominant under independent private values. With value 27, bid 27 to maximize expected profit. Overbidding risks winning at a price above value if others deviate; underbidding sacrifices profitable wins. Ties are random; $0.1 increments provide no strategic gain here. No prior history to exploit this round.

[ In a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy. It ensures you win exactly when the price (second-highest bid) is below your value and maximizes expected profit regardless of others’ strategies. With only one round, there’s no benefit to shading or overbidding. My value is $31, so I bid exactly my value. ]

[ In a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values, the weakly dominant strategy is to bid your true value. Overbidding risks winning when the second-highest bid exceeds your value (negative profit), and underbidding risks losing when you would have profited. There is no useful history and only 1 round, so no strategic deviations. With value $20, bid exactly 20 to maximize expected profit. ]
